Example environment configuration file for AWS, NGROK, Auth0, PostgreSQL, and OpenAI API keys.

# Purpose
This configuration file stores environment variables for various services and APIs used in the software application. It includes placeholders for AWS credentials (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_REGION`), NGROK API key (`NGROK_API_KEY`), Auth0 configuration (`AUTH0_URL`, `AUTH0_DOMAIN`, `AUTH0_MGMT_API_CLIENT_ID`, `AUTH0_MGMT_API_CLIENT_SECRET`, `AUTH0_MGMT_API_AUDIENCE`), PostgreSQL database credentials (`POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_DB`), OpenAI API key (`OPENAI_API_KEY`), and Modal token credentials (`MODAL_TOKEN_ID`, `MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET`). These variables are essential for authenticating and connecting to the respective services.
